title: i18n(console): the 问 AI launcher's amber marker still reads "a proposed plan is waiting" when what waits is a single write, in all eleven packs
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Blocked-by: #37970

## Why this matters

C4 (#37860, PR #37970) lights the 问 AI launcher's amber marker in two cases: a proposed plan waiting for approval, as before, and now also a single write waiting for approval. Its accessible description and tooltip, `console.ai.dock.planAwaitingApproval`, still say only "A proposed plan is waiting for your approval" in all eleven locale packs. A user with a pending write who hovers the marker, or hears it read by a screen reader, is told about a plan that does not exist. They then look for a plan card and miss the write card that is actually waiting. The C4 thread found this and left it out of that PR's scope.

## Where

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts:3225` (on PR #37970's head `f738217a`), `planAwaitingApproval: 'A proposed plan is waiting for your approval'`, and the same key in the other ten packs.
- Used by `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AssistantTopBarButton.tsx:115` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ChatDock.tsx:787`.
- Pinned by `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/launcherPlanApprovalMarker-11666.test.tsx`.

## Acceptance

- The marker's text is true in both cases. Either one wording covers both (for example "Something is waiting for your approval"), or the marker picks a plan text or a write text by what is actually pending. The implementer picks which and says why in the PR.
- All eleven packs are updated. A pack whose translation is not settled follows the repo's i18n fallback rule instead of keeping the stale English meaning.
- The marker pin test checks the text for a pending write as well as for a pending plan.

## Out of scope

When the marker lights, and the open-type rules (ADR-0057 A5), are C4's and are not changed here.
